trade.text: Whitesides criticized tariffs for raising costs and said they were hurting small businesses in his district.
trade.quote: He said small-business owners in his district are struggling to keep their doors open because of Trump’s tariffs.

debt.text: Whitesides supports protecting Social Security and other vital programs as part of his economic agenda.
debt.quote: protecting vital programs like Social Security and Medicaid

housing.text: Whitesides called for signing a housing bill intended to increase the housing supply and lower costs.
housing.quote: would increase the housing supply and lower costs for American families

schools.text: Whitesides says he is investing in public education and supporting local schools, teachers and students.
schools.quote: By investing in our students, our public education system, our community colleges, and our workforce development pipeline

safety.text: He says he wants to increase funding for local law enforcement to get illegal guns off the streets.
safety.quote: increase funding for local law enforcement so they can get more illegal guns off our streets and out of the hands of dangerous criminals

immigration.text: Whitesides said he supports securing the border while providing legal pathways to citizenship, particularly for undocumented immigrants brought to the country as children.
immigration.quote: Whitesides said he supports commonsense reforms that secure the border while providing legal pathways to citizenship, especially for undocumented immigrants brought to the U.S. as children.

guns.text: He says he supports comprehensive background checks and campaigns on gun-violence-prevention measures such as expanding background checks to all gun sales.
guns.quote: Whitesides said that he supports comprehensive background checks

abortion.text: He says everyone should be free to make their own reproductive health decisions and cosponsors legislation to codify abortion rights nationally.
abortion.quote: Everyone should have the right to make their own healthcare decisions, including those related to reproductive health and abortion access, free from government interference.

health.text: Whitesides opposed policies he said would remove Americans from health care and has fought efforts to cut Medicaid.
health.quote: He’s fought against efforts to cut Medicaid and Social Security

energy.text: Whitesides introduced a bill described as lowering energy costs and modernizing the electric grid.
energy.quote: The Lowering Energy Costs through Grid Modernization Act would speed deployment of advanced conductors on existing power line corridors, getting cheaper energy to consumers faster.

tax.text: Gibbs's campaign pledges to lower the cost of living by opposing new taxes and cutting wasteful government spending.
tax.quote: Jason will fight to lower the cost of living by opposing new taxes, supporting energy affordability, and holding government accountable for wasteful spending.

safety.text: Gibbs says he would support law enforcement, oppose policies he describes as soft on crime, and restore consequences for criminal behavior.
safety.quote: Jason will support law enforcement and stand up to the "soft-on-crime" policies that are letting repeat offenders walk free.

immigration.text: Gibbs's campaign calls for securing the border, cracking down on fentanyl trafficking, and ending policies that reward illegal entry.
immigration.quote: Jason supports securing the border, cracking down on fentanyl trafficking, and ending policies that reward illegal entry.

energy.text: Gibbs says he will support energy affordability to help ease the cost of living for California families.
energy.quote: opposing new taxes, supporting energy affordability, and holding government accountable for wasteful spending.
